code.value:
from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class DiagnosticGate(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='sufficient',method='route_sufficient',group_outputs=True,allows_loop=True,cache=False),Output(name='rule',method='route_rule',group_outputs=True,allows_loop=True,cache=False),Output(name='proposal',method='route_proposal',group_outputs=True,allows_loop=True,cache=False),Output(name='stop',method='route_stop',group_outputs=True,allows_loop=True,cache=False)]
 def choose(self):
  selected=payload(self.value).get('route','stop')
  excluded=[name for name in ('sufficient','rule','proposal','stop') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_sufficient(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_rule(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_proposal(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_stop(self)->Data:return self.choose()
